I seem to recall that Spirit Summoning Chamber could
be used to get a thaumaturgy card that used Thaumaturgy
and another discipline (Armor of Terra for instance)
so I would be inclined to say yes.

And in a similar line I would think that True Brujah could NOT use
cards like Shadow Feint (assuming they were given a celerity skill card)
as it requires celerity (although it is in addition to obfuscate)

Further I would assume that a True Brujah with Spiritus (don't ask me why)
could use Swiftness of the Stag at the Spiritus level.

Hope this helps rather than confuses....
but as per usual, IANLSJ
